title: Oral History Interview with Gordon E. Moore and Jay T. Last
version: Science History Institute transcript; interview 2006; digital transcription
lineage: Retrospective participant oral history prompted by surviving notes. Supports a 1958 report, not a precisely dated first experiment or an Atalla-to-Hoerni influence claim.
